LanguageData.CC_Post_Opened_Text_2: Their goods used to come all the way from {FROM}. Now {PEOPLE} have opened {POST}, a {KIND} of theirs {WHERE}, to trade with {COLONY} from close by.
LanguageData.CC_Post_Opened_Text_3: {PEOPLE} have traded with {COLONY} often enough that {FROM} is too far to send everything from. They have opened {POST}, a {KIND} of theirs {WHERE}.
LanguageData.CC_Post_Opened_Text_NoFrom_2: {COLONY} has traded with {PEOPLE} often enough that they have opened {POST}, a {KIND} of theirs {WHERE}, to be nearer to it.
LanguageData.CC_Post_Opened_Keeper_2: {KEEPER} keeps it as their {TITLE}, and has sent word that the colony's people will be welcome there in any season.
LanguageData.CC_Post_Opened_Keeper_3: {KEEPER}, their {TITLE} there, sends greetings, and asks that the colony's traders come and see the place for themselves.
LanguageData.CC_Post_Opened_Keeper_NoName_2: Their {TITLE} there has sent word that the colony's people will be welcome at the post in any season.
LanguageData.CC_Post_Warned_Text_2: {KEEPER} has written from {POST}. {PEOPLE} will not keep a {KIND} open for a colony they are on bad terms with, the {TITLE} says, and unless things mend with {COLONY}, it will close.
LanguageData.CC_Post_Warned_Text_NoName_2: The {TITLE} at {POST} has written. Unless things mend between {PEOPLE} and {COLONY}, the {KIND} will close.
LanguageData.CC_Post_Mended_2: Things have mended between {PEOPLE} and {COLONY}, and {KEEPER} writes from {POST} that the {KIND} will stay open.
LanguageData.CC_Post_Mended_NoName_2: {POST} will stay open, now that {PEOPLE} and {COLONY} are on better terms again.
LanguageData.CC_Post_Sacked_Text_2: {POST} has been sacked. Raiders of {ENEMY}, at war with {PEOPLE}, came on the {KIND} {WHERE} and stripped it, and what they could not carry they broke. Its people are still there and mean to stay, but it will be poorer for a long while.
LanguageData.CC_Post_Closed_Soured_2: Things never mended between {PEOPLE} and {COLONY}, and {POST}, their {KIND} {WHERE}, is closed. Its people have gone home with what they could carry, and left {LEFT}.
LanguageData.CC_Post_Closed_War_2: {PEOPLE} and {COLONY} are at war, and no {KIND} of theirs stays open for an enemy. {POST}, {WHERE}, has been packed up and left. There is nothing there now but {LEFT}.
LanguageData.CC_Post_Closed_Sacked_2: Raiders of {ENEMY} have sacked {POST}, the {KIND} {PEOPLE} kept {WHERE}, and it will not be rebuilt. Its families are on the road home, and nothing is left there but {LEFT}.
LanguageData.CC_Post_Razed_2: {POST} is gone, razed by {COLONY}. {PEOPLE} opened that {KIND} to trade with the colony, and they will remember who brought it down.
LanguageData.CC_Hamlet_Harvest_Coming_2: {HAMLET} has its harvest in, and a carter is on the road up to the colony's gate with {GOODS}, the first of it.
LanguageData.CC_Hamlet_Harvest_Coming_3: {LEADER} has sent a carter up from {HAMLET} with {GOODS}, the first of the harvest, for the colony's gate.
LanguageData.CC_Hamlet_Harvest_Left_2: {HAMLET}'s carters have left {GOODS} at the colony's gate, the first of what their fields gave this year.
LanguageData.CC_Hamlet_Help_Food_2: {LEADER} sends word that the families at {HAMLET} have started eating their seed. If the colony could spare {GOODS}, carried down to their carter at the gate, they could keep the rest for planting.
LanguageData.CC_Hamlet_Help_Doctor_2: A sickness has gone through {HAMLET}, and the families have nothing to treat it with. {LEADER} asks whether the colony's doctor could bring {GOODS} down to their carter at the gate, and say how it should be used.
LanguageData.CC_Hamlet_Help_Tools_2: A hard season has found {HAMLET} short of everything at once. {LEADER} asks for {GOODS}, carried down to their carter at the gate, to keep the place standing until it turns.
LanguageData.CC_Hamlet_Refused_2: {LEADER} has the colony's answer, and {HAMLET} will get through this season without its help.
LanguageData.CC_Hamlet_NotYet_2: {HAMLET} will wait for its oath, and {LEADER} will ask again when the colony is ready.
LanguageData.CC_Hamlet_End_Broken_2: Twice this season {HAMLET} asked the colony for help, and twice it was refused. {LEADER} has told the families not to look to the colony again. The tie is broken, and {HAMLET} is simply a town of {PEOPLE} now.
LanguageData.CC_Hamlet_End_Failed_2: {HAMLET} could not last. Its people are giving up the hamlet the colony took under its protection, and its families are leaving.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Leaving_2: {MEANS}: the families of {TOWN}, {WHERE}, are packing up for {NEXT}. {PEOPLE} are giving the town up.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Leaving_3: {MEANS}: {TOWN} of {PEOPLE}, {WHERE}, is emptying. Its families are taking the road to {NEXT}, and the town is being given up.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Leaving_NoNext_2: {MEANS}: {PEOPLE} are giving up {TOWN}, {WHERE}, and its families are leaving with whatever they can carry.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_HeldOn_2: {MEANS}: {TOWN}, {WHERE}, is not quite empty. A few families stayed when the rest left, and {PEOPLE} have let them keep the town.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Empty_2: {MEANS}: {TOWN}, {WHERE}, stands empty, the last of {PEOPLE} gone from it. What remains is {RUIN}.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Empty_3: {MEANS}: the road out of {TOWN}, {WHERE}, is quiet again. {PEOPLE} have gone, and left {RUIN} behind them.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Fell_2: {MEANS}: {TOWN} of {PEOPLE}, {WHERE}, did not come through the fighting. All that stands there now is {RUIN}.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Fell_Ours_2: {TOWN} of {PEOPLE}, {WHERE}, is {RUIN} now, after the colony's people were done there.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Faded_2: {MEANS}: the ruin of {TOWN}, {WHERE}, has gone back to the land, and travelers no longer turn aside for it.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Faded_3: {MEANS}: the last walls of {TOWN}, {WHERE}, have come down, and the place is hard to find now.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Daughter_2: {MEANS}: {MOTHER} has grown too full for its families, and some have gone out to found {TOWN} of {PEOPLE}, {WHERE}, {RITE}.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Back_Tribal_2: {MEANS}: {PEOPLE} have gone back to {TOWN}, {WHERE}. The old hearths there burn again, and the elders have blessed the stones.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Back_Medieval_2: {MEANS}: there is smoke over {TOWN}, {WHERE}, again. Families of {PEOPLE} have come back to the old walls and are roofing the houses.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Back_Industrial_2: {MEANS}: {PEOPLE} have reopened {TOWN}, {WHERE}. Settlers are clearing the old streets and getting the water running again.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Back_Spacer_2: {MEANS}: {TOWN}, {WHERE}, is back on {PEOPLE}'s charts. Settlers have reopened the old habitats and are bringing the systems back up.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Newcomers_Tribal_2: {MEANS}: the old walls of {TOWN}, {WHERE}, belong to a clan of {PEOPLE} now. They have kept the old name, and made new hearths in the old houses.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Newcomers_Medieval_2: {MEANS}: {PEOPLE} have taken up the empty town of {TOWN}, {WHERE}. The new families keep its old name, and have already raised a market cross.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Newcomers_Industrial_2: {MEANS}: new settlers of {PEOPLE} are living in the old streets of {TOWN}, {WHERE}, under its old name, and the first shops are open.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Newcomers_Spacer_2: {MEANS}: {PEOPLE} have registered the derelict colony at {TOWN}, {WHERE}, as their own, keeping its old name on the charts.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Renamed_Tribal_2: {MEANS}: a clan of {PEOPLE} lives in the old walls of {TOWN}, {WHERE}, now. The place is {NEWNAME} at their fires.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Renamed_Medieval_2: {MEANS}: the old walls of {TOWN}, {WHERE}, have new families of {PEOPLE} in them and a new name, {NEWNAME}.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Renamed_Industrial_2: {MEANS}: {TOWN}, {WHERE}, is called {NEWNAME} now. Settlers of {PEOPLE} have moved into its empty streets and painted over the old signs.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Renamed_Spacer_2: {MEANS}: the derelict colony at {TOWN}, {WHERE}, is {NEWNAME} now, chartered to {PEOPLE} and lit again.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Begun_2: {MEANS}: {FOUNDER} has led settlers of {PEOPLE} out of {MOTHER} to begin a town {WHERE}.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Begun_3: {MEANS}: there are settlers of {PEOPLE} {WHERE}, out from {MOTHER}, putting up a town under {FOUNDER}.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Begun_NoMother_2: {MEANS}: {FOUNDER} has led settlers of {PEOPLE} out to begin a town {WHERE}.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Begun_NoFounder_2: {MEANS}: families of {PEOPLE} have come out from {MOTHER} to begin a town {WHERE}.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Begun_NoFounder_NoMother_2: {MEANS}: families of {PEOPLE} are putting up a town {WHERE}.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Built_2: {MEANS}: the town {PEOPLE} began {WHERE} is finished. It is called {TOWN}, {RITE}, and {FOUNDER} is its {TITLE}.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Built_NoFounder_2: {MEANS}: the settlers of {PEOPLE} {WHERE} have finished their town, {TOWN}, {RITE}.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_Say_2: There's a camp out to the {DIR}, and it isn't anyone friendly.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_Say_3: Someone's camped to the {DIR}, and they're watching us.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_Say_Visitor_2: There's a {KIND} off to the {DIR}, we gave it a wide berth on the way here.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_RaidText_2: Fighters have come out of the {KIND} of {PEOPLE} {WHERE}.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_RaidText_3: The {KIND} of {PEOPLE} {WHERE} has sent its fighters toward the colony.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_Beaten_2: The raiders from the {KIND} have been beaten off. Of the {SIZE} {PEOPLE} sent, {DOWN} fell or were taken.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_End_Broken_2: Nothing stands at the {KIND} of {PEOPLE} {WHERE} now but cold fires and trampled ground. Its fighters are dead, taken or scattered, and its raids are over.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_End_Paid_2: The silver was collected at the edge of the colony's ground, and {PEOPLE} have broken camp {WHERE}. Their word is to keep away from {COLONY} for a year.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_End_Peace_2: {PEOPLE} are at peace with {COLONY} now, and their {KIND} {WHERE} has been struck.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_End_Burned_2: The {KIND} of {PEOPLE} {WHERE} is ashes. {ALLIES} of {ALLY} came on it and burned it, and {ALLY} count it a good turn done for the colony.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_End_GaveUp_2: {PEOPLE} have had enough of being beaten off. Their {KIND} {WHERE} stands empty, and they have moved on.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_End_GaveUp_Time_2: {PEOPLE} have given up waiting for their chance at the colony. Their {KIND} {WHERE} stands empty.
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_Say_2: There's news from {TOWN}, and it's worth hearing.
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_Say_3: They were all talking about one thing in {TOWN}.
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_Say_4: You're a long way from {TOWN}, so let me tell you what's going on there.
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_Say_5: Sit down, I've news from {TOWN} you won't have heard.
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_Told_2: {X_nameDef} of the {CAMP} sat {A_nameDef} down at their fire with the news from {TOWN}, {WHERE}: {NEWS}
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_war_2: {PEOPLE} and {ENEMY} are at war, and {TOWN} is getting ready for it.
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_peace_2: {PEOPLE} and {ENEMY} have made peace, and {TOWN} has been celebrating.
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_new_2: {PEOPLE} raised {TOWN} only this year, and it is still half built.
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_site_2: Travelers on the road speak of {SITE}, {DIR} of {TOWN}.
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_quest_2: In {TOWN} they are still asking for someone to take on "{QUEST}".
LanguageData.CC_Travel_Quarrel_Say_2: I staked that rock first, and you know it.
LanguageData.CC_Travel_Quarrel_Say_3: Go and find your own seam.
LanguageData.CC_Travel_Came_ruins_2: It was {SEEK} that brought them this far out.
LanguageData.CC_Travel_Came_ruins_3: They had heard of {SEEK}, and wanted to see them before anyone else did.
LanguageData.CC_Travel_Came_ore_2: Word of {SEEK} had reached them, and they want to see it for themselves.
LanguageData.CC_Travel_Came_trees_2: They came to see {SEEK}, and to sit under it a while.
